errors.unreachable: The smart-me module is not answering. Check that it is powered, connected to Wi-Fi and that Modbus TCP is enabled in the smart-me portal.
errors.invalid_ip: Enter a valid IP address, for example 192.168.1.194.

pair.title: Connect to the smart-me module
pair.intro: Enable Modbus TCP for the module in the smart-me portal under advanced settings, then enter the module's IP address. You find it in your router's list of connected devices.
pair.ip_hint: Reserve this address for the module in your router so it never changes.
pair.testing: Connecting to the module, this can take up to 20 seconds...
pair.refused: The module refused the connection. Check that Modbus TCP is enabled for it in the smart-me portal.
pair.unreachable: Nothing answered at this address. Check the IP address and that Homey and the module are on the same network.
pair.no_answer: The module accepted the connection but did not answer. Wait a minute and try again.
pair.no_mac: Homey could not identify the module on the network. Make sure it is on the same network as Homey.
pair.already_added: This module has already been added.

warnings.stale: The meter values haven't changed for more than 3 minutes. Check that the meter encryption key is entered for the module in the smart-me portal and that the module is online.
